schedule.title: Automatic Backup Schedule
schedule.desc: While the schedule is active, the panel scans every hour; a backup is produced in the matching hour slot and backups outside the retention window are deleted.

none.name: Off
none.desc: No automatic backup. Manual "Backup Now" only.

daily.name: Daily
daily.desc: A backup is produced every day at the selected hour, last N kept.

weekly.name: Weekly
weekly.desc: One backup every 7 days, more economical disk usage.

schedule.retention_hint: Older auto-backups beyond this number are deleted. Manual backups are preserved.
schedule.saved_on: Automatic backup active: {{freq}}, {{hour}}:00, last {{retention}} backups kept

destination.title: Remote Backup Destination
destination.desc: After a backup is produced it's uploaded to a remote server in the background — off-site protection against disk failure.
destination.endpoint_hint_s3: (can be left empty for Amazon S3)
destination.active_checkbox: Active (every backup is sent to this destination)
destination.delete_confirm: Delete the remote backup destination? Existing backups are not affected, only future automatic uploads stop.

restore_modal.title: Restore from backup
restore_modal.scope_full: Entire account — files, databases and email
restore_modal.path_label: File path relative to account home directory
restore_modal.warning: Existing data in the selected section will be replaced with the backed-up version. This action cannot be undone.
